notes: Bullet 2 is an OR, not a sequence: 'Talk to Qutiba or Ulamaal'. It is modelled as a two-member group so both draw at once and the player takes whichever they reach -- prereq.lua treats grouped steps as current together, which is exactly the shape an OR wants, and it costs nothing here because both stand at (K-12) in the same room. Recording only Qutiba would have hidden the other for no gain. The Shararat Teahouse is inside Aht Urhgan Whitegate rather than a zone of its own, so all four rungs share one zone. Topok-Hippok is named in bullet 1 as the person you are helping; you never interact with him on this page, so he is not a target. Fame is written as the expansion name, 'Treasures of Aht Urhgan'; the resolver folds that to the real Aht Urhgan region, and FLevel is empty, so it gates nothing either way. Nothing in this quest is observable -- no key item, no drop, the reward is Imperial Bronze Pieces -- so every step's evidence is null and the ladder rests on the session latch.

Bullet 3 names its monsters only as 'crawlers', so the mob is recorded as the singular 'Crawler' -- the West Sarutabaruta mob of that exact name, the page's own word depluralised, not a guess at which variant. The sub-bullet under bullet 2 is the page telling you an optional 50-gil trade 'isn't necessary' -- and it would cost you the epistle -- so it is a note, not a rung.
